title.narrative: Cambodia Export Diversification and Expansion Program (CEDEP) II

description.narrative: The Royal Government of Cambodia (RGC) has established a Trade Sector-Wide Approach (Trade SWAp) under the leadership of the Ministry of Commerce to manage and coordinate better the use and implementation of its Aid for Trade. Trade SWAp has three main strategic #Pillars.# Pillar 2 focuses on strengthening the export supply capacity of 19 potential sectors (products and services) identified in the Cambodia Trade Integration Strategy 2007 (DTIS 2007.) The main objective of the #Cambodia Export Diversification and Expansion Program# (CEDEP) I and II is to strengthen and diversify export supply capacity in five of the eight (out of 19) Pillar 2 sectors that have been identified by the Government as export sectors requiring immediate, priority action. They include: rice, silk, cassava, fish, tourism, garment, processed Food and manufacturing assembly. In line with the Government#s wishes to tap into the best possible support capacity from its development partners, each component of this EIF Tier 2 proposal will have its own Main Implementing Entity (MIE): UNDP for Cassava, UNIDO for Marine Fisheries Products, and Shift 360 for RACA.
